calculators.name: Part Assembly - Manual MIG welding
calculators.description: Manual MIG welding of a weldment, per weld: the wire the machine feeds deposits weld metal at its feed rate over the wire's section, times arcEfficency (the share of the wire that ends up in the weld, memory/Part Assembly: 0.5); the arc time is the weld's metal (its length over its cross-section) at that rate, times the machine's arc time standard. A seam is tacked first, a tack every tack pitch; the gun is placed for each weld and cleaned for its share of the arc. The components are loaded first (componentLoadTime_manual_mig_welding, by each one's weight) and the weldment unloaded (unloadWeldmentAllowance_manual_mig_welding, by its weight). The wire it uses (its metal over arcEfficency) is the weld's material.

source.engine: weld_length_mm (the weld's length; a plug weld: its plate thickness per plug)
weld_area_mm2 (the weld's cross-section, from its joint type and size)
weld_count (the welds, one arc each)
tacked (1 for a seam, tacked before it is welded; 0 for a plug or a tack weld)
load_time_s (componentLoadTime_manual_mig_welding: each component by its weight; 0 when an earlier welding step loaded them)

fields.name: Wire Area
fields.formula: pi * {Wire Diameter} ^ 2 / 4

fields.name: Deposition Rate
fields.formula: {Wire Feed Rate} * {Wire Area} * {Arc Efficiency}

fields.name: Arc Time
fields.formula: {Weld Length} * {Weld Metal Area} / {Deposition Rate} * {Arc Time Standard}

fields.name: Tack Time
fields.formula: {Tacked} * {Weld Length} / max({Tack Pitch}, 1) * {Tack Length} * {Weld Metal Area} / {Deposition Rate}

fields.name: Gun Time
fields.formula: {Welds} * {Gun Placement Time} + {Arc Time} * {Gun Clean Per Arc}

fields.name: Wire Mass
fields.formula: {Weld Length} * (1 + {Tacked} * {Tack Length} / max({Tack Pitch}, 1)) * {Weld Metal Area} / {Arc Efficiency} * {Weld Density} / 1000000000

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: ({Arc Time} + {Tack Time} + {Gun Time} + {Load Time} + {Unload Allowance}) * {Cycle Time Factor}

calculators.name: Part Assembly - Robotic MIG welding
calculators.description: Robotic MIG welding of a weldment, per weld: the deposition of Part Assembly - Manual MIG welding (wire feed rate over the wire's section, times arcEfficency; the weld's metal at that rate, times the machine's arc time standard), tacks every tack pitch, the gun placed and cleaned, shared by the machine's weld heads. The components are loaded (componentLoadTime_robotic_mig_welding) and the weldment unloaded (unloadWeldmentAllowance_robotic_mig_welding); each weld's program (the machine's programming time per weld) is shared by the batch.

source.engine: weld_length_mm (the weld's length; a plug weld: its plate thickness per plug)
weld_area_mm2 (the weld's cross-section, from its joint type and size)
weld_count (the welds, one arc each)
tacked (1 for a seam, tacked before it is welded; 0 for a plug or a tack weld)
load_time_s (componentLoadTime_robotic_mig_welding: each component by its weight; 0 when an earlier welding step loaded them)

fields.name: Wire Area
fields.formula: pi * {Wire Diameter} ^ 2 / 4

fields.name: Deposition Rate
fields.formula: {Wire Feed Rate} * {Wire Area} * {Arc Efficiency}

fields.name: Arc Time
fields.formula: {Weld Length} * {Weld Metal Area} / {Deposition Rate} * {Arc Time Standard}

fields.name: Tack Time
fields.formula: {Tacked} * {Weld Length} / max({Tack Pitch}, 1) * {Tack Length} * {Weld Metal Area} / {Deposition Rate}

fields.name: Gun Time
fields.formula: {Welds} * {Gun Placement Time} + {Arc Time} * {Gun Clean Per Arc}

fields.name: Wire Mass
fields.formula: {Weld Length} * (1 + {Tacked} * {Tack Length} / max({Tack Pitch}, 1)) * {Weld Metal Area} / {Arc Efficiency} * {Weld Density} / 1000000000

fields.name: Programming Per Part
fields.formula: {Welds} * {Programming Time Per Weld} / max({Batch Size}, 1)

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: (({Arc Time} + {Tack Time} + {Gun Time}) / max({Weld Heads}, 1) + {Load Time} + {Unload Allowance}) * {Cycle Time Factor} + {Programming Per Part}

calculators.name: Part Assembly - Manual spot welding
calculators.description: Manual resistance spot welding of a weldment: each spot takes the machine's spot weld time and a gun placement. The components are loaded (componentLoadTime_unlabelled, the one load table memory/Part Assembly gives no other welding process: manual spot welding) and the weldment unloaded (memory has no unload table for manual spot welding; the three it has are identical, the manual MIG one is read).

source.engine: spot_count (the spot welds)
load_time_s (componentLoadTime_unlabelled: each component by its weight; 0 when an earlier welding step loaded them)

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: ({Spots} * ({Spot Weld Time} + {Gun Placement Time}) + {Load Time} + {Unload Allowance}) * {Cycle Time Factor}

calculators.name: Part Assembly - Robotic spot welding
calculators.description: Robotic resistance spot welding of a weldment: each spot takes the machine's spot weld time and a gun placement, shared by its weld heads. The components are loaded (componentLoadTime_robotic_spot_welding) and the weldment unloaded (unloadWeldmentAllowance_robotic_spot_welding); each spot's program (the machine's programming time per weld) is shared by the batch.

source.engine: spot_count (the spot welds)
load_time_s (componentLoadTime_robotic_spot_welding: each component by its weight; 0 when an earlier welding step loaded them)

fields.name: Programming Per Part
fields.formula: {Spots} * {Programming Time Per Weld} / max({Batch Size}, 1)

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: ({Spots} * ({Spot Weld Time} + {Gun Placement Time}) / max({Weld Heads}, 1) + {Load Time} + {Unload Allowance}) * {Cycle Time Factor} + {Programming Per Part}

calculators.name: Part Assembly - Laser seam welding
calculators.description: Laser seam welding of a weldment: the seam's length at the travel speed of laserSeamWeldTravelSpeed for the material's cut code family, the laser's power and the weld's depth (the table's speeds are round inches per second times 2.54: read as cm/s), plus the machine's load, unload and index times, once per weldment (on its first seam; the engine reads them from the machine).

source.engine: weld_length_mm (the seam's length)
load_time_s (the machine's load time, once per weldment: on its first seam)
unload_time_s (the machine's unload time, once per weldment: on its first seam)
index_time_s (the machine's index time, once per weldment: on its first seam)

fields.name: Weld Time
fields.formula: {Weld Length} / ({Travel Speed} * 10)

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: ({Weld Time} + {Load Time} + {Unload Time} + {Index Time}) * {Cycle Time Factor}

calculators.name: Part Assembly - Bevel cutting
calculators.description: The bevel cut before a groove weld: its length at the cut speed of bevelCutSpeed for the bevel's depth (an oxy-fuel table for steel), plus a pierce per bevelled edge.

source.engine: bevel_length_mm (the length of the bevelled edges)
bevel_count (the bevelled edges, one pierce each)

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: ({Bevel Length} / ({Cut Speed} / 60) + {Bevels} * {Pierce Time}) * {Cycle Time Factor}

calculators.name: Part Assembly - Grinding
calculators.description: Grinding the welds of a weldment along their length at the machine's grinding speed.

source.engine: ground_length_mm (the length of the welds ground)

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: {Ground Length} / {Grinding Speed} * {Cycle Time Factor}

calculators.name: Part Assembly - Finish grinding
calculators.description: Finish grinding the welds of a weldment along their length at the machine's grinding speed (memory/Part Assembly gives it the grinding machine's speed).

source.engine: ground_length_mm (the length of the welds finish ground)

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: {Ground Length} / {Grinding Speed} * {Cycle Time Factor}

calculators.name: Part Assembly - Wire brushing
calculators.description: Wire brushing the welds of a weldment along their length at the machine's brushing speed.

source.engine: brushed_length_mm (the length of the welds brushed)

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: {Brushed Length} / {Brushing Speed} * {Cycle Time Factor}
